opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme (A) up to £200 for travel/accommodation to GS/SIG meetings; Scheme (B) up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards) for non-GS meetings; Scheme (C) up to £300 for virtual conference registration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme (A) open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdocs within six years of PhD viva; Schemes (B) & (C) open to PhD students and postdocs within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs for GS/SIG meetings, non-GS meetings, and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses or collaborative visits to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects whose results would be suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings and events, to be used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship: a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, or major sponsorship of an entire meeting (recent major sponsorship levels between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members organising genetic-themed meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of the meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in, or with strong links to, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
